title: Nine Pounds of Wool
subtitle: 毯子与覆盖 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 毯子与覆盖（生活与学习·居家与器物）
meta: 主题语境：毯子与覆盖（生活与学习·居家与器物）　|　核心词汇：blanket　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 blanket 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my grandmother was given ① a blanket that had been woven for somebody else, and she said the weaving was the whole of the gift. The ② blanket, meaning the wool and not the warmth, weighed nine pounds and was mended in March by somebody who never said so; a blanket, she said, is the only thing you own that is measured by how well it hides a repair.

Every ③ blanket in that house came from the same loom, and the ④ blanket on the end of the bed, meaning the one kept for the worst nights and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever fought over. A blanket, my mother said, is nine parts wool and one part knowing which bed is coldest; my grandmother said the wool is the part you can feel.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ blanket was the whole of the field, meaning the covering and not the wool. The ⑥ blanket, meaning the layer over everything and not any of that, is the only thing in a garden that everybody spreads and nobody folds; a blanket, he said, is either something you sleep under or the only word that means both a cover and a layer. She said the layer came first.

By 1966 the ⑦ blanket had become a photograph in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the weight. The ⑧ blanket of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was nine pounds of wool and eleven years of mending; a blanket, she said, is either the thing on the end of the bed or the reason you know which room is warmest. He said the warmest room has never needed one.

The ⑨ blanket I remember is the one on the end of the bed, which was still in use in 1971 and was never washed. A ⑩ blanket, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being mended; every blanket, she said, is a layer that has agreed to look like a cover. She said the layer was never the point.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 毯子（指那块毛料，与温暖相对）
C. 固定搭配：be given a blanket 得到一条毯子
D. n. 毯子（指屋里每一条）
E. n. 毯子（指床尾那一条）
F. n. 覆盖层（指盖住田地的那层东西）
G. n. 覆盖层（抽象：铺在上面的那一层）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a blanket that had been woven for somebody else
The blanket, meaning the wool and not the warmth
the blanket on the end of the bed
blanket was the whole of the field
The blanket, meaning the layer over everything

answers.why: be given a blanket 意为“得到一条毯子”，1947 年有人给了祖母一条原本为别人织的毯子。
blanket 意为“毯子”，指那块毛料而不是温暖，它重九磅，三月被一个从没说出口的人补过。
blanket 指屋里每一条毯子，那屋里每一条都来自同一台织机。
blanket 指床尾那一条（留着过最难熬的夜晚的那条），是唯一有人争过的。
blanket 意为“覆盖层”，指盖住田地的那层东西，父亲说 blanket 就是那块地的全部。
blanket 为抽象用法，指铺在上面的那一层，是园子里人人都铺开、却没人折叠的东西。
blanket 意为“毯子”，到 1966 年这个 blanket 成了商品目录里的一张照片。
blanket 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九磅羊毛和十一年的缝补。
blanket 意为“毯子”，我记得的是床尾那一条，1971 年还在用，从没洗过。
blanket 为抽象总称，母亲说毯子是唯一会因为被补过而变好的东西。
